queries.cypher_template: MATCH (n) WHERE n.kfm_migration_window_id = $migration_window_id AND $label IN labels(n) AND n.kfm_snapshot_ref IN [$before_snapshot_ref, $after_snapshot_ref] RETURN $label AS scope, sum(CASE WHEN n.kfm_snapshot_ref = $before_snapshot_ref THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS before_count, sum(CASE WHEN n.kfm_snapshot_ref = $after_snapshot_ref THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS after_count ORDER BY scope
